facts.fact: The US State Department's release on the Health Cooperation Framework signed on 4 December 2025 says US funding, within up to US$1.6 billion over five years, will support the scale-up of Kenya's health data systems, including accelerating the national rollout of Kenya's electronic medical record systems; it gives no amount for the record systems.

The United States and Kenya signed a five-year Health Cooperation Framework on 4 December 2025 whose data systems provision includes accelerating the national rollout of Kenya's electronic medical record systems, as the US State Department announced that day.

systems.tiers: national rollout to be accelerated; no tier given

note: A press release announcing the instrument held as document 35; the record systems are named generically, with no product, tier or count. The archived capture is truncated in its last bullet.
